turn_text: What would some of those things be to get at the deficit spending? Are we expecting to see large impacts on the deficit with tariffs or what other things are being looked at?

So there's been a lot of talk about Medicaid cuts. Even with reducing Medicaid spending some, there still won't be a cut. There still will be an overall growth in spending on Medicaid. What we're looking at doing is very sensible common sense things that I think quite honestly, most North Dakotans would assume are already in place. That's just not sustainable. We have to make these reforms to make sure that the program is viable long term for the very people who depend on it, count on it the most.
